title: Compromised customer-support account
scenario: Alex Lee's account shows an unfamiliar sign-in and a new mailbox-forwarding rule.

prompts.question: Who coordinates the response before technical work begins?
prompts.observation: The team discussed actions but did not name an incident coordinator.
prompts.action: Assign an incident coordinator before technical work begins.

prompts.question: Who approves a customer-facing message?
prompts.observation: The communications lead can draft a message, but no approver was recorded.
prompts.action: Name an approver for customer-facing messages.

prompts.question: Who may revoke the account during containment?
prompts.observation: The team proposed revoking sessions without recording decision authority.
prompts.action: Record who may revoke the account during containment.

prompts.question: How is recovery verified before closure?
prompts.observation: The credential reset was discussed, but no post-restore verification was defined.
